acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (registry-derived binding values): for the accepted rectangle fixture lot, every envelope dimension equals the tightest applicable rule's declared bound (value-pinned against the ruleset fixtures); a registry where a direction is unbounded yields an honest unbounded/gap entry, never an invented ceiling; no hand-copied constant exists (every bound cites the registry lookup).
AS-2 (provenance): each dimension names its binding rule id and the out-competed rule ids; mutation-flipping the binding rule in a test registry flips the named id (test-pinned).

AS-3 (honest gaps): a lot/registry combination whose yard/setback rules cannot be computed emits the typed gap with reason; the gap appears in the route response; nothing is silently omitted (enumerate-the-dimensions test).

AS-4 (generator-checker consistency): check_proposal on the emitted candidate returns PASS for every computable check at the derived values; the at-cap-exact boundary matches the checker's semantics (a +epsilon mutation FAILs the check).

AS-5 (determinism + route discipline): byte-stable output across repeated calls; the route refuses typed and bounded (over-cap body, malformed, flag-off 404 sentinel); UNMOUNTED (absent from the app's openapi; main.py untouched); no persistence.
